mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals increased demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals increased consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth is negative.
